turns.reply: I made one change in `fastapi/_compat/v2.py`: `create_body_model` now builds the combined body model with `ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)`, so arbitrary types no longer break multi-parameter request bodies. The issue text was vague, so this is a best-guess fix. I checked it with a small script and a few existing body tests, which passed, but I did not add a dedicated test for the issue's exact scenario.
